source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Round 1 is usually paired at random. For later rounds, pair players by these criteria in turn:

1. Record (wins, losses and draws), e.g. pairing 2 players at 3–1.
2. Win path: when in the event each player won or lost.
3. At random, among players level on both.

recommendedOrder: record of wins, losses and draws
random among players meeting both previous criteria
